note: The methodology changelog. Every published print records the methodology_version it was computed under; this file says what each version was and why it changed. It is committed data rather than page copy so that a version appearing in the ledger with no explanation here is a detectable gap rather than an invisible one.
composition: A methodology version is the tracked agent set combined with the pinned parser: anything that can change a verdict from identical raw evidence. It is composed from those two rather than written by hand, so neither can be bumped without the ledger noticing.

versions.changed: Initial agent set of 16 tokens, classified with protego 0.6.2 against a frozen 1,000-domain panel.
versions.why: The starting point, published so that later changes have something to be measured against.

versions.summary: Agent set expanded from 16 tokens to 45.
versions.changed: Added 29 tokens: operator-run crawlers that were live and widely named in robots.txt but untracked. Generic scraping tooling was deliberately not added, since a site naming it is not stating a position on AI crawling.
versions.why: An audit of tokens appearing in the collected files found the original set incomplete enough to understate the headline: Anthropic was tracked by one of four live tokens, and Meta's fetcher, Cohere's training crawler and Mistral were absent entirely. Every affected published figure was restated as a new vintage with this reason recorded, rather than edited.
